headline: GOLD TOPS $4,389 FOR BEST AUGUST SINCE 2020 AS CPI+PPI MISS SLASHES RATE-HOLD ODDS TO 69%
snippet: Back-to-back inflation misses — July CPI +0.1% (annual 3.4%) and July PPI flat at 0.0% vs 0.2% consensus — sent gold up 10% in August to $4,389/oz, its strongest monthly move since January. Silver hit $67.20 on CPI day before settling near $66. Fed funds futures now price a 69% probability the Fed holds in September, up from roughly 45% before the data.

headline: COCHILCO CUTS CHILE 2026 COPPER OUTPUT FORECAST TO 5.27M TONNES, LIFTS PRICE TARGET TO $5.95/LB
snippet: Chile's copper commission Cochilco revised 2026 national output down 2.6% year-over-year to 5.27 million tonnes after setbacks at Codelco, Escondida and Spence. Simultaneously, the agency raised its 2026 copper price forecast to $5.95/lb and projects a rebound to 5.55 million tonnes in 2027 as delayed expansion projects come online.

headline: MAKO MINING Q2 RECORD: $62.6M REVENUE, $31.7M EBITDA, $2,286/OZ AISC ON 14,610 OZ SOLD
snippet: Mako Mining (TSX-V: MAKO) posted Q2 2026 records across the board: 14,610 oz gold sold generating $62.6M revenue, $31.7M adjusted EBITDA, and EPS of $0.16/share. AISC came in at $2,286/oz. The company ended the quarter with $112M cash, providing a strong runway for the San Albino expansion in Nicaragua.

headline: GOGOLD Q3 RECORD $26.3M OPERATING CASH FLOW; LOS RICOS SOUTH SILVER MINE NOW FULLY FUNDED
snippet: GoGold Resources (TSX: GGD) reported fiscal Q3 2026 record operating cash flow of $26.3M on $27.8M revenue (419,986 AgEq oz) driven by Parral tailings operations. Management confirmed the Los Ricos South silver mine construction is now fully funded from internal cash generation. The company holds approximately $262M cash, eliminating dilution risk for the build.

headline: PROSPECTOR METALS DRILLS 7.3 G/T AU, 22.26 G/T AG, 0.89% CU OVER 5.15M IN YUKON — DISTRICT-SCALE TESS ZONE EMERGES
snippet: Prospector Metals (TSX-V: PPP) reported hole ML26-043 at the TESS Zone returning 7.3 g/t Au, 22.26 g/t Ag and 0.89% Cu over 5.15m from 101.3m depth, including a 25.6 g/t Au high-grade core over 1.3m. The 2026 program has completed 44 holes (13,074m) defining a 200m-strike, 150m-depth gold-copper zone at the ML Project in Yukon — a potential district-scale discovery.

headline: KALKINE CANADA: ENDEAVOUR SILVER, SILVERCORP, PREDICTIVE DISCOVERY, ALLIED GOLD ON AUGUST WATCHLIST
snippet: Kalkine Canada highlights four precious-metals names spanning the development spectrum for August 2026: Endeavour Silver (TSX: EDR) and Silvercorp Metals (TSX: SVM) on the producer side, Predictive Discovery (ASX: PDI) at the developer stage, and Allied Gold (TSX: AAUC) as the wildcard — previously the target of a $3.9B Zijin bid that establishes a clear valuation floor.

headline: RARE EARTH PRICES RETREAT 11.9% FROM JULY PEAK; NDPR FALLS BELOW DOD-BACKED $110/KG FLOOR
snippet: Thirteen of nineteen rare earth elements declined in August, with average prices down 5.4% and the median off 9.2%. NdPr — the magnet metal that anchors most Western project economics — retreated 11.9% from its July high, slipping below the $110/kg floor referenced in US Department of Defense offtake negotiations. China's industry index sits at 267.0 as of August 4. Analysts note structural supply deficits remain intact for a second consecutive year despite the pullback.

headline: US URANIUM REVIVAL AT 18-YEAR OUTPUT HIGH SPARKS TRIBAL AQUIFER CONTAMINATION CONCERNS IN WYOMING, COLORADO
snippet: An MPR News/NPR investigation documents rising tribal and community health concerns near in-situ recovery (ISR) uranium operations in Wyoming and Colorado as Q1 2026 domestic US production hits an 18-year high. ISR — the method used by Peninsula Energy at Lance and UEC at Palangana — injects acidic solutions into aquifers to dissolve uranium ore, raising contamination risk questions regulators are under pressure to revisit.

headline: COMEX COPPER WAREHOUSES SWELLING AS IMPORTERS FRONT-RUN TARIFFS; LME INVENTORIES NEAR EMPTY
snippet: US importers are flooding COMEX copper warehouses ahead of a potential tariff announcement, creating an unusual two-market structure: COMEX stockpiles surging while LME inventories hover near empty. The divergence explains how copper simultaneously hit all-time highs and triggered LME emergency backwardation intervention. The COMEX/LME premium spread is the widest since Q1 2025 tariff fears.
